password.description: Choose a new password of at least 12 characters. You are signed out everywhere afterwards and sign in again with the new one.
password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

mfa.title: Multi-factor authentication
mfa.description: Add a second step to your sign in with an authenticator app.
mfa.forced: It is required for your account and cannot be turned off.
mfa.scan: Scan the QR code using your authenticator app.
mfa.codesText: Multi-factor authentication is on. Keep these recovery codes in a safe place: each works once, and they are not shown again.
mfa.verifyText: Enter the 6 digit code your authenticator app shows.
mfa.savedCheck: I have saved my recovery codes
mfa.cantScan: Can't scan the QR code? Show setup key
mfa.changeConfirm: Your current authenticator stops working now, and you set up a new one next. Until you finish, your account is protected by the password only.
mfa.disableConfirm: Turn off multi-factor authentication? Your account will be protected by the password only, and the recovery codes are deleted.
mfa.reauth: Confirm it is you: enter your password and a code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password. A passkey also counts as the second step.
passkeys.name: Name of the passkey
passkeys.limit: You have the maximum of {{max}} passkeys.

passkeys.addPasswordText: Enter your password to add it. Your device then asks you to confirm.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: The browsers and devices where you are signed in. Signing out a session ends it at once; an app that already holds an access token may keep working for a few more minutes.
sessions.revokeOthers: Sign out of all other sessions
sessions.confirmRevoke: Sign out “{{name}}”? That session ends at once.
sessions.confirmRevokeCurrent: “{{name}}” is the session you are using now. You will be signed out immediately.
sessions.confirmRevokeOthers: Sign out of every session except this one? Those devices have to sign in again.
sessions.revokedOthers: Signed out of the other sessions.
